scenes.problem: Evaluate 2³ + √36 × ∛8. Show the order of operations.
rows: Identify the power 2³ and the two roots before multiplying or adding.
scenes.misconception: Work through powers and roots, then multiplication, then addition.

scenes.problem: A square has area 64 cm². Find its side length and perimeter.
rows: Label the equal sides s. Area = s × s = 64 cm².
Take the nonnegative square root: s = √64.
Arrange 64 square centimetres in a 8 by 8 square.
So the side length is 8 cm.
The perimeter is four sides: 4 × 8 = 32 cm.
scenes.memo: 8 × 8 = 64 cm², and four sides total 32 cm.
scenes.misconception: Area has square units, perimeter has linear units; a square has four equal sides.

scenes.problem: A cube has volume 125 cm³. Find one edge length.
rows: Label all three equal edges s; volume = s × s × s.
Build 5 equal layers, each 5 by 5 unit cubes.
scenes.misconception: Volume counts three equal dimensions; an edge uses linear units.
